project.name: memory-box
project.productType: Collaborative pixel canvas with notes, photos, build-on links and grounded Find/Ask

design.density: Compact working chrome around a full-viewport canvas

preferredPrimitives: Native buttons with Base UI Tooltip
Original 32px pixel objects for six creation/exploration tools

must: White/pastel pixel identity; actual stored artwork keeps its colors and positions
All six tool labels visible on touch; stationary hit targets at least 44px
No fabricated participants, stories or activity
Keep real-time, painting, private image upload, build-on and source-backed search behavior
Respect reduced motion; retain keyboard focus and tooltip dismissal
avoid: Marketing slogans or starter counters around the canvas
Idle floating objects, confetti, autoplay or perpetual bounce
Large motion runtimes for simple visual feedback

decisions.reason: Actual authored materials remain visible at every zoom; place-preserving presets and unseen-story wandering open a spatial Read/Build on/Next preview. Reuse the source-anchored composer with a bounded mobile sheet, restored draft neighborhood, factual labels and visible explicit threads. Only later received new/updated originals receive a capped 1800ms highlight with static reduced-motion feedback. Preserve compact white/pastel pixel chrome, real cursor/painting layers and stored authorship without fabricated activity, new rendering/motion dependencies or migrations.

User requested smaller non-canvas UI with the cute pixel style throughout. A 56px header, 344px dock and 316px desktop panels use plum ink, butter primary actions and lilac tabs. Short labels use Pixelify; longer text stays readable. Mobile targets remain at least 44px, sheets scroll, dock artwork motion is limited to 2px and 6%, and persistent gesture instructions are removed.

User authorized a more bubbly, tactile, animated refinement of the existing canvas. Distance-based dock artwork motion is adapted from 21st Motion Primitives references; CSS preserves fixed targets and no runtime dependency. Paper tint connects composing to placing. Motion is bounded and user-initiated.
